openai.responseText:
Here are the **best master-planned communities in the Sarasota–Bradenton area** that are most consistently associated with **strong public-school zones** (plus a few “check this street address” notes, because zoning can change by neighborhood and even by side of a road).

## Top picks (master-planned + strongest “family/schools” reputation)

### 1) **Lakewood Ranch (Manatee + Sarasota counties)**
**Why it’s a top choice:** It’s one of the largest, most established master-planned communities in the region, with many neighborhoods feeding into **high-performing Manatee County schools** (and some into Sarasota County). It also ranks extremely high nationally for master-planned community sales. ([rclco.com](https://www.rclco.com/publication/the-top-selling-master-planned-communities-of-2024/?utm_source=openai))  
**School-zone notes (depends on village/neighborhood):**
- Common high-school assignments in/around LWR include **Lakewood Ranch HS** and **Braden River HS** (both widely regarded as strong options in Manatee).  
**Lifestyle/format:** Lots of distinct villages (Waterside, Greenbrook, Country Club, etc.), extensive amenities, broad housing mix.

### 2) **Palmer Ranch (Sarasota)**
**Why it’s a top choice:** A long-running Sarasota master-planned area with many neighborhoods that tend to feed into well-regarded Sarasota County schools, and great access to I-75, Costco area, and beaches. Sarasota County Schools has maintained an **“A” district grade** in Florida’s school grading releases. ([sarasotacountyschools.net](https://www.sarasotacountyschools.net/article/2300107?utm_source=openai))  
**School-zone notes:** Palmer Ranch assignments often vary by subsection, but frequently connect to high-performing Sarasota-area schools (confirm for the exact address).  
**Lifestyle/format:** Multiple subdivisions rather than one “town center” feel; very convenient location.

### 3) **Wellen Park (Venice / South Sarasota County)**
**Why it’s a top choice:** One of Florida’s and the nation’s top-selling master-planned communities recently, with major amenities and new development (including the Braves’ spring training complex). ([rclco.com](https://www.rclco.com/publication/the-top-selling-master-planned-communities-of-2024-florida-edition/?utm_source=openai))  
**School-zone notes:** This is in **Sarasota County Schools (A-rated district overall)**, but specific school assignments depend heavily on the neighborhood and can shift as new schools open/redistricting occurs. ([sarasotacountyschools.net](https://www.sarasotacountyschools.net/article/2300107?utm_source=openai))  
**Lifestyle/format:** Newer inventory, lots of community programming, growing commercial core.

## Also worth considering (depending on budget + exact school target)

### 4) **Waterside at Lakewood Ranch (Sarasota side of LWR)**
**Why:** You get the Lakewood Ranch master-plan + a more Sarasota-oriented location, and you may land in Sarasota County school zoning depending on the specific section (verify by address).

### 5) **University Park / UTC-adjacent planned neighborhoods**
Not always marketed as one single MPC the way LWR/Wellen Park are, but there are several **planned communities** around UTC/University Parkway with strong convenience + commonly sought-after school zones. Worth shortlisting if commute to Tampa/airport/UTC matters.

---

## How to ensure you’re really getting “top-rated schools” (fast checklist)
1) **Pick your must-have schools first** (e.g., a specific elementary and high school), then shop communities that feed them—zoning beats “community reputation.”
2) **Verify by exact address** using the district boundary tools (Sarasota County Schools vs Manatee County Schools), because “Lakewood Ranch” spans areas and assignments can differ.
3) If you tell me:
   - kids’ grades (or “elementary only,” “middle,” etc.)
   - budget range
   - commute targets (downtown Sarasota? Bradenton? Tampa airport?)
   - preference for newer builds vs mature trees/older homes  
…I’ll narrow this to a **shortlist of 5–8 specific neighborhoods/villages** and the **most likely school assignments** for each.

gemini.responseText:
The Sarasota-Bradenton area is home to some of the nation’s top-selling master-planned communities, many of which are specifically designed around "A-rated" school districts. Below are the best communities categorized by their specific school zones and academic performance for the 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school years.

### **1. Lakewood Ranch (Sarasota & Manatee Counties)**
Consistently ranked as the #1 multi-generational community in the U.S., Lakewood Ranch is widely considered the gold standard for school-focused families.
*   **Top-Rated Schools:**
    *   **Elementary:** Robert Willis (A), Gilbert W. McNeal (A), and B.D. Gullett (A). McNeal has held an "A" rating since 2004.
    *   **Middle:** R. Dan Nolan (A) and Dr. Mona Jain (A). Both are high-performing schools with heavy community involvement.
    *   **High:** Lakewood Ranch High School (A). It maintains a 97% graduation rate and a strong college acceleration program.
*   **Unique Features:** The community features an "educational hub" design where schools are often within walking or biking distance of residential villages. 
*   **Note:** The southern section (**Waterside**) is in Sarasota County and is currently zoned for **Tatum Ridge Elementary (A)** and **Booker High (B)**, though a new K-8 school is planned for that area by 2028.

### **2. Palmer Ranch (Sarasota County)**
An established, upscale community in South Sarasota known for its mature landscaping and central location.
*   **Top-Rated Schools:**
    *   **Elementary:** Ashton Elementary (A) or Gulf Gate Elementary (A). Ashton is frequently ranked in the top 5% of all Florida elementary schools.
    *   **Middle:** Sarasota Middle School (A), which is a top-10% school statewide.
    *   **High:** Riverview High School (A). Known for its prestigious International Baccalaureate (IB) program and award-winning music department.
*   **Bonus:** Residents are also in close proximity to **Pine View School (A)**, the #1 ranked public school in Florida for gifted students (grades 2-12).

### **3. Wellen Park (Venice/North Port)**
Formerly known as West Villages, this is one of the fastest-growing areas in Florida and is investing heavily in new academic infrastructure.
*   **Top-Rated Schools:**
    *   **Elementary:** Taylor Ranch Elementary (A).
    *   **Secondary:** Currently served by **Venice High School (A)**, which is highly regarded for its athletics and academics.
    *   **Charter:** College Preparatory Academy at Wellen Park recently improved to an "A" rating.
*   **Future Growth:** A brand-new **Wellen Park High School** is set to open in August 2026, along with a new K-8 school on the same campus to alleviate overcrowding and provide state-of-the-art facilities.

### **4. Skye Ranch (Sarasota County)**
A newer community east of I-75 that is currently transitioning into its own dedicated school zone.
*   **Top-Rated Schools:**
    *   **K-8 Innovation:** The **Skye Ranch School (K-8)** is opening in **August 2025**. It will be a state-of-the-art STEM-focused facility.
    *   **Transition Zoning:** Currently, students are primarily zoned for high-performing schools like **Lakeview Elementary (A)** and **Sarasota Middle (A)**.
    *   **High:** Riverview High School (A) or Sarasota High (A), both of which are high-performing institutions.

### **5. North River Ranch (Parrish/Bradenton)**
Located in the northern part of Manatee County, this community is the "new" frontier for families seeking brand-new homes with high academic standards.
*   **Top-Rated Schools:**
    *   **Elementary:** Barbara A. Harvey Elementary (A).
    *   **Middle:** A new North County/North River Ranch Middle School is opening in **August 2025**.
    *   **High:** Parrish Community High School (A). This school earned its first "A" rating in 2024 and features modern career academies in medical and technical fields.

### **Summary Table: Best Communities by Grade Level (2025 Updates)**

| Community | Elementary | Middle | High School |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Lakewood Ranch** | Willis / McNeal (A) | Nolan / Mona Jain (A) | Lakewood Ranch High (A) |
| **Palmer Ranch** | Ashton / Gulf Gate (A) | Sarasota Middle (A) | Riverview High (A) |
| **Wellen Park** | Taylor Ranch (A) | Venice Middle (A) | Venice High (A) |
| **North River Ranch**| Barbara Harvey (A) | New Parrish Middle (2025) | Parrish Community (A) |
| **Skye Ranch** | Skye Ranch K-8 (2025) | Skye Ranch K-8 (2025) | Riverview / Sarasota High (A) |

**Pro Tip:** Always verify the specific address on the [Sarasota County School Zone Lookup](https://www.sarasotacountyschools.net/page/school-maps) or [Manatee County School Locator](https://www.manateeschools.net/locator) before purchasing, as boundaries can shift due to the rapid growth in these communities.
